description:
Original mod by: fire_turtle

An alien faction arrives in the north-eastern corner of the core worlds after an eternity of wandering, with exotic-looking high-tech ships that also utilize a considerable number of missiles and fighters in addition to energy weapons.

Major changes since 0.25.3:
```
Updated to version 0.97
Ambush-class frigate: system changed to "temporal interruptor" that slows the timeflow of a nearby targeted ship
Some balance changes, check Changelog_EN for details
Sprite update for a few projectiles
```


Download: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=14ofSbuB1RQIlq_NLoBQAJ40x7GZiptv9
